facts.text: My dad is a deep sea diver and a war hero. Eat your kai and I'll tell you more.
facts.why: Invented line signed Boy. His real stories are about Michael Jackson and his father's supposed past, but this wording is not in the IMDb quotes. A real line: 'Hey Auntie, can I have an ice block please?'
